caption: The drawing depicts a single ornate object that appears to be a vessel, chalice, or ceremonial container rendered in grayscale with pencil or ink, accented with very light shading to indicate dimension. The base is circular and flat, providing a stable platform for the structure. Rising from the base, the body of the vessel is enclosed by four elongated, ribbed or beaded vertical elements that curve outwards before converging at the neck. These vertical elements are connected by two horizontal bands that cross at the widest point of the vessel's body. Above the neck, there is a sculpted figure resembling an animal or bird with an upturned head and exaggerated features, forming the uppermost part of the object. The background is plain and unadorned, consisting of a light tan or beige paper without any additional designs or objects. The entire drawing is monochromatic, with varying intensities of gray and subtle shadowing used to suggest volume and three-dimensionality.
title: Bottle
